description: Conservation of each GCM consensus match between S. purpuratus and L. variegatus, against a within-locus null
code:
import re,numpy as np,pandas as pd,matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def rd(c): return open(f"out/{c}.fa").read().strip()
def rc(s): return s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))
K=10; FL=150
def kset(s): return {s[i:i+K] for i in range(len(s)-K+1) if "N" not in s[i:i+K]}
def shared(a,b): return len(kset(a)&(kset(b)|kset(rc(b))))
CASES=[("gcm -4062\n(functional)","gcm_win",13380,"ATGCGGGC","Lvar_gcm_big","#c0392b"),
       ("pks -1437\n(functional)","pks1_win",8563,"ATGCGGGT","Lvar_pks1_big","#c0392b"),
       ("pks +5020","pks1_win",15020,"ATGCGGGT","Lvar_pks1_big","#7f8c8d"),
       ("pks +7111\n(in exon)","pks1_win",17111,"ATGCGGAC","Lvar_pks1_big","#7f8c8d"),
       ("gatae -12448\n(candidate)","gatae_win",7552,"ATGCGGAT","Lvar_gatae_big","#e67e22")]
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); labs=[];vals=[];nulls=[];cols=[]
for name,spf,pos,word,lvf,col in CASES:
    sp=rd(spf); lv=rd(lvf); spflank=sp[pos-FL:pos+FL+8]
    occ=[m.start() for m in re.finditer("(?="+word+")",lv)]+[m.start() for m in re.finditer("(?="+rc(word)+")",lv)]
    best=max([shared(spflank,lv[max(0,o-FL):o+FL+8]) for o in occ],default=0)
    null=np.array([shared(spflank,lv[p:p+2*FL+8]) for p in rng.integers(0,len(lv)-2*FL-9,400)])
    labs.append(name); vals.append(best); nulls.append(np.percentile(null,99)); cols.append(col)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
x=np.arange(len(labs))
ax.bar(x,vals,color=cols,width=.6,label="best Sp/Lv flank match at a motif occurrence")
ax.plot(x,nulls,"k_",ms=30,mew=2,label="99th percentile of 400 random Lv windows")
for i,(v,n) in enumerate(zip(vals,nulls)):
    ax.text(i,v+1.5,("0 occurrences\nin 323 kb" if v==0 else f"{v}"),ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("shared 10-mers between the 308 bp Sp and Lv flanks")
ax.set_yscale("symlog"); ax.set_ylim(0,120)
ax.set_title("Cross-species test: only one of two functionally validated Gcm sites is conserved in L. variegatus,\nand the gataE candidate is not",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5,loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
